integrity: Exact finite combinatorial identity, analytically controlled complex generating-function expansion, exact rational checker. Numerical checks are not represented as an infinite proof. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: One repeated multiplicity asymptotic to a positive constant times square root of sample size; no other multiset profile or all-regime universality is proved. Originality remains subject to independent priority review.
title: Sharp Poisson approximation for one square-root multiset block
